name: Easy Grow Obby
desc:
Welcome to Easy Grow Obby!

WORLD 5 RELEASED!
NEXT UPDATE AT 75K LIKES!!

It's practically an Obby/Parkour game, except that you have the ability to change your size: decreasing or increasing, so basically you can Grow and Shrink, with 35 levels that gonna make you have to use this ability to reach the end.

Premium Benefits: Gravity Coil

We kindly ask you to like and favorite our game so that we can bring you new games and updates.

From the same creators of "Obby But you Can't Jump" and multiple other games...
